mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.company_id, m.facility_id, COALESCE(f.facility_name, '기업 전체') AS facility, f.facility_type, i.category::text AS category, i.sub_category, i.indicator_code, i.title, m.reporting_year, LPAD(m.period_value::text, 2, '0') AS month_value, m.reporting_year || '-' || LPAD(m.period_value::text, 2, '0') AS period, m.activity_value, m.numerical_value, m.text_value, i.unit, COALESCE(m.additional_info ->> 'sourceSystem', m.data_source_type) AS source, m.data_source_type, m.status::text AS status, m.evidence_file_url, COALESCE(ai.analysis_status, 'WAITING') AS ai_status, COALESCE(ai.risk_level, 'LOW') AS risk_level, ai.summary AS ai_summary, ai.model_name, input_user.name AS assignee, approver.name AS approver, m.reject_reason, m.additional_info::text AS additional_info, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON f.id = m.facility_id LEFT JOIN users input_user ON input_user.id = m.input_user_id LEFT JOIN users approver ON approver.id = m.approver_user_id LEFT JOIN esg_ai_analyses ai ON ai.metric_data_id = m.id
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.action_type, h.from_status::text AS from_status, h.to_status::text AS to_status, h.comment, COALESCE(u.name, '시스템') AS actor_name, h.acted_at FROM esg_approval_history h LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = h.actor_user_id WHERE h.metric_data_id = #{metricId} ORDER BY h.acted_at DESC, h.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_ai_analyses ( metric_data_id, analysis_status, risk_level, summary, findings, model_name, analyzed_by, analyzed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{metricId}, #{status}, #{riskLevel}, #{summary}, CAST(#{findings} AS jsonb), #{modelName}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (metric_data_id) DO UPDATE SET analysis_status = EXCLUDED.analysis_status, risk_level = EXCLUDED.risk_level, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, findings = EXCLUDED.findings, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, analyzed_by = EXCLUDED.analyzed_by, analyzed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO esg_approval_history ( metric_data_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, comment, actor_user_id, acted_at ) VALUES ( #{metricId}, #{actionType},
CAST(#{fromStatus} AS data_status_enum) NULL , CAST(#{toStatus} AS data_status_enum), #{comment}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esg_ai_analyses WHERE metric_data_id = #{metricId} AND analysis_status = 'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE environment_monthly_data e SET approval_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = e.company_id AND m.facility_id = e.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'ENVIRONMENT' AND m.status = 'REJECTED' ) THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = e.company_id AND m.facility_id = e.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'ENVIRONMENT' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = e.company_id AND m.facility_id = e.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'ENVIRONMENT' AND m.status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'DRAFT' END, approved_at = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = e.company_id AND m.facility_id = e.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'ENVIRONMENT' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND e.base_period = #{period}

UPDATE social_monthly_data s SET approval_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = s.company_id AND m.facility_id = s.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'SOCIAL' AND m.status = 'REJECTED' ) THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = s.company_id AND m.facility_id = s.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'SOCIAL' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = s.company_id AND m.facility_id = s.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'SOCIAL' AND m.status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'DRAFT' END, approved_at = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = s.company_id AND m.facility_id = s.facility_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'SOCIAL' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND s.base_period = #{period}

UPDATE governance_monthly_data g SET approval_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = g.company_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'GOVERNANCE' AND m.status = 'REJECTED' ) THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = g.company_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'GOVERNANCE' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = g.company_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'GOVERNANCE' AND m.status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'DRAFT' END, approved_at = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = g.company_id AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category = 'GOVERNANCE' AND m.status != 'APPROVED' ) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE g.company_id = #{companyId} AND g.base_period = #{period}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM environment_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM social_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM governance_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM environment_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period} AND approval_status != 'APPROVED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM social_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period} AND approval_status != 'APPROVED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM governance_monthly_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{period} AND approval_status != 'APPROVED' )

SELECT i.indicator_code, AVG(m.numerical_value) AS average_value, SUM(m.numerical_value) AS total_value FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT AND m.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY i.indicator_code

SELECT SUM(e.electricity_usage_kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(e.production_ton), 0) FROM environment_monthly_data e WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.base_period = #{period} AND e.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_scores ( company_id, reporting_year, reporting_period, period_value, total_score, e_score, s_score, g_score, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{year}, 'MONTHLY', #{month}, #{totalScore}, #{eScore}, #{sScore}, #{gScore}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (company_id, reporting_year, reporting_period, period_value) DO UPDATE SET total_score = EXCLUDED.total_score, e_score = EXCLUDED.e_score, s_score = EXCLUDED.s_score, g_score = EXCLUDED.g_score, calculated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
